properties.name: udak.enabled
properties.description: Enable UDAK Observe beans and allow opting in to JDBC.

properties.name: udak.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Enable the JDBC executor when exactly one DataSource is present.

properties.name: udak.jdbc.vendor
properties.description: Database vendor required when UDAK JDBC is enabled.

properties.name: udak.jdbc.max-rows
properties.description: Maximum query result rows, from 1 to 1000.

properties.name: udak.jdbc.query-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Query timeout in seconds, from 1 to 30.

properties.name: udak.mode
properties.description: The only supported mode is observe.

properties.name: udak.legacy.default-mode
properties.description: The legacy setting accepts only observe.

properties.name: udak.rewrite.enabled
properties.description: Automatic SQL rewrite is disabled. True is rejected.

properties.name: udak.legacy.rewrite.enabled
properties.description: Automatic legacy SQL rewrite is disabled. True is rejected.

properties.name: udak.observability.log-parameters
properties.description: SQL parameter logging is disabled. True is rejected.
